lead: `Core\Attributes` retrieval reads any *recognized* attribute's payload, and `get<T>` answers only the first of two on one method.
body: `rule:attributes/structural-retrieval` is structural, so `Core\Attributes::get<{name: string, about: string}>(Deploy::deploy(...))` answers a `#[Core\Command]`; read an alias with `all<T>` and index it. A payload-less `#[Option]` is indistinguishable from no attribute.
